Command.Name: ReadInfoFromLastServerCommunication
Command.FPOperation: Provide information from the last communication with the server.

Arg.Name: OptionServerResponse
Arg.Desc: 1 symbol with value - 'R' - At send receipt - 'Z' - At send EOD

Arg.Name: OptionTransactionType
Arg.Desc: 1 symbol with value - 'c' - Error Code - 'm' - Error Message - 's' - Status - 'e' - Exception Message - 'r' - Response Code

Res.Name: OptionServerResponse
Res.Desc: 1 symbol with value - 'R' - At send receipt - 'Z' - At send EOD

Res.Name: OptionTransactionType
Res.Desc: 1 symbol with value - 'c' - Error Code - 'm' - Error Message - 's' - Status - 'e' - Exception Message - 'r' - Response Code

Res.Name: Message
Res.Desc: Up to 200 symbols for the message from the server
